description.value:
Reaving is the rarest aetherfont in Ardor. Unlike other aetherfonts, reavers can only sustain their ether by utilizing ether within living or spiritual beings – sometimes even the recently deceased -- or taking it for themselves. It is said that to accomplish this feat, their souls possess the power to reach out to ether through the souls or the blood of others. For this reason, they are often faced with prejudices of being corpse-eaters, vampires or ghouls, to the point where the stigma has disproportionately led reavers to ether deficiencies. However, on average reavers need to only consume fresh meat or vegetables (sometimes raw) to meet their needs, if they are not active. Adventuring reavers, however, need to be more creative.

Reaver Focus Point Feature

Reavers start with varying focus points after their daily preparations depending on the activities they take as part of it. These activities are similar to their Refocus activities, which include the consumption of food, communion to borrow ether from spirits, or absorption of ether from recently fallen corpses or remnants.

You also can channel a connection another creature’s ether to pull it away from them to take as your own. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.feats.EI6tbxtfyMoiIGov]{Drain Ether} focus cantrip. As it is a cantrip, its spell level is automatically heightened to equal to half your level rounded up. You choose the spellcasting tradition of this cantrip, and it uses the higher of your spell DC or class DC. When you acquire this feature, choose which saving throw the cantrip will use. You can take a week of downtime to retrain the saving throw selected.

When you acquire a mote of ether from your Reaver features, instead of immediately using it, you can stow it within you instead as a free action. Once stowed, you can later choose to use it as normal as a single Interact action. Alternatively, when you use your focus points, you can make use of the stowed mote to negate one point of the focus point cost. You can only stow one mote at a time, and the mote dissipates after ten minutes. At 10th level, a stowed mote negates two points of a focus point cost.

Reaver Refocus

When Reavers refocus, they incorporate one of the below deeds as part of their Refocus. Depending on circumstance, these may require skill checks such as Society or Survival (to subsist and find fresh food), or Arcana or Occultism (drawing in ether from corpses or remnants), or Nature or Religion (to commune with spirits) which would take up the ten-minute period. If they have ready access to any source for their focus points, they are free to perform other activities during the ten-minute period. At the end of the activity, they gain 1 focus point.

Refocus activities include:

  • Eating fresh meat, fruit or vegetables, which have not been heavily cooked/processed. Dried foods and general rations usually do not provide the sustenance required for a focus point.

  • Absorbing ether from a recent corpse, including undead or remnant remains.

  • Communing and borrowing power from any present spirits; you must be able to communicate with them in some fashion to entreat power from them in this way.

If you select a feat that improves your Refocus, you can gain an additional focus point in the ten-minute period by doubling up on an activity or performing multiple of the above activities.
